name: What does the vanity replacement process involve with Bay City Remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What does the vanity replacement process involve with Bay City Remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms handles the entire vanity replacement from initial planning to final inspection. The process begins with assessing your space, plumbing layout, and storage preferences during a consultation. The crew disconnects existing water and drain lines, disposes of the old unit, repairs compromised drywall, and confirms plumbing rough-ins align. Once the new vanity, sink, faucet, and countertop are leveled and secured, all plumbing connections are tested for leaks, and edges are sealed with waterproof silicone.
acceptedAnswer.description: The team handles removal, drywall prep, plumbing adjustments, vanity anchoring, countertop and sink installation, faucet hookup, and complete leak testing.
